note:
R52 — gen7 equipment: the complete component set per equipment id (which (part, variant, kind) files every shipped id of a family has),
so a reassignment can be validated against ids that carry the full set and a new-id registration knows every file to place. Read-only
directory listings of the loose `rendering/<family>/` trees (X360 11 / 13 / 15 / Legacy, PS3 15 / Legacy).

Tokenisation as the 2026-09-21 r38 grammar: `<prefix>_<n1>[_<n2>[_<n3>]][_<kind>].rx2|.rpsgl`, prefix = part (glove / feglove / helmet / visor /
chinstrap / cage / goaliehelmet …), n1 = the equipment id, n2 / n3 = variant / sub-variant, kind = texture kind (dm tm nm sm am csm cm …)
or absent = mesh. Per (family, part): mesh containers (no kind suffix) are reported separately as shared meshes; for the textured parts the id is the first number, except blocker / trapper / goalie-mask paint where it is the second (first = style / shell); per id the signature = sorted set of (n2, n3, kind); the census of signatures; required components =
the (n2, n3, kind) present for 100 % of the part's ids; optional = present for some; ids with an incomplete set relative to the majority
signature are listed. Cross-platform: PS3 vs X360 signature equality per (family, part, id).
Usage: python r52_gen7_equipment_component_sets.py <out.json> [--trees x360-legacy,ps3-legacy,...]
